blurb: Triple Match is a minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game.
description:
Triple Match is a minimal, open-source 3D tile-matching puzzle game.

Privacy-First:
Triple Match is designed to respect user privacy unconditionally. It collects no data, contains no trackers, and works 100% offline.

- No Telemetry or Tracking: Zero analytics, crash reporters, tracking SDKs, or device identifiers.
- No Accounts or Sign-ins: No account creation, email capture, or profile requirement. Just open and play.
- 100% Offline Play: Operates entirely on-device without internet access. No server dependencies.
- Zero Ads: No ad networks, tracking beacons, or cross-site fingerprinting scripts.
- Local-Only Storage: Game progress and settings are stored locally on your device. Data never leaves your hardware.
- Transparent and Open Source: Clean, inspectable codebase with minimal dependencies. No hidden data collection routines.
